subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Sport: sport I like, why we have rules in sport and why playing sport is good for me

show.line: Sport keeps our bodies strong and happy. We play fair and follow the rules.

rounds.prompt: Which sport do we play in water?
Why do we have rules in sport?
Good for our bodies or not? Sort them.

hints: Sport makes our hearts and muscles strong.
Rules keep a game fair and safe.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! We are playing soccer.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will pick up the ball and run with it!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! In soccer we kick, not carry.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Soccer rules say kick the ball. We play fair!

parent_line: Can name a sport, say why rules matter and why sport is good for us.
